subject.title: feat(control-ui): render Mermaid code fences in webchat

question: Should maintainers close this stale Mermaid branch now, or sponsor/ask for a fresh current-main replacement implementation?
rationale: Current main still lacks the requested feature, but the submitted branch is conflicting, targets obsolete paths, and introduces a security-sensitive SVG/dependency boundary that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Close and invite fresh PR
